title: Lee Vung Hwe

page_data.en:
A.P
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Shanghai Municipal Council.
853
23/10/16
AH
October 23rd 1916

Sir,
During the last two days there has been four cases of snatching of the funds when being conveyed from the office for distribution to the applicants.
The French Police has visited all the rebel offices and cautioned the occupants to behave themselves in a peaceful manner.
The rebels who have received funds for repatriation show no signs of leaving Shanghai.
On the afternoon of the 22nd inst about 30 rebels speaking the Hupeh dialect were loitering around Lai Nyi Too, Pootung 烂泥渡路 Their object has not yet been ascertained.
Representatives of the rebels met representatives of the Chamber of Commerce in the Yih Ping Shiang 一品香 restaurant, Thibet Road, on the 22nd inst. The question of an increased grant of money was discussed but no decision was arrived at.
The applicants for repatriation funds on the 21st only amounted to three tenths of the lists made up for that date but on the 22nd about eight tenths of the number arranged for received the grant. The applicants included the followers of Han Hwo.
Payment will be made to-day to the persons on the lists as previously arranged. Since the commencement of the distribution of the repatriation funds troops have been stationed at about twenty yards interval along the road from St. Catherine's Bridge to the Arsenal. An escort of two soldiers is also sent as far as the Frenchtown boundary with all the rebel leaders who draw a considerable sum of money.
Two of the rebel leaders named Lee Vung Ho 李文光军 of Hunan and Zung Tse Tien 程再天 of Hupeh have absconded with funds amounting to $2,200.00 entrusted to them for distribution among their followers.

Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

A.P
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
上海工部局。
853
23/10/16
AH
1916年10月23日

先生：

在过去两天内，发生了四起在运送款项前往分发给申请人途中遭抢夺的案件。

法国巡捕房已走访所有叛军办事处，警告 occupants 保持和平行为。

已领取遣返经费的叛军人员并无离开上海的迹象。

本月22日下午，约30名讲湖北方言的叛军在浦东烂泥渡路（Lai Nyi Too）附近徘徊。其目的尚未查明。

本月22日，叛军代表与商会代表在西藏路一品香餐厅（Yih Ping Shiang）会面。讨论了增加拨款的问题，但未达成任何决定。

21日申请遣返经费的人数仅占当日名单人数的十分之三，但22日约有八成预定人员领取了拨款。申请人中包括韩武（Han Hwo，音译）的部属。

今日将按先前安排向名单上的人员付款。自开始分发遣返经费以来，沿从圣凯瑟琳桥（St. Catherine's Bridge）至兵工厂的道路，每隔约二十码便部署有士兵。凡领取大额款项的叛军首领，均派两名士兵护送直至法租界边界。

两名叛军首领，即湖南人李文光（Lee Vung Ho）和湖北人程再天（Zung Tse Tien），携款潜逃，该笔款项共计2,200.00美元，原系委托他们分发给其部属。

您的顺从仆人，
总探长。

警察总监上尉。
